title: Integration of solar passive heating strategies in low-cost biogas plants
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00441A, Paper
Juan Guillermo Jaramillo, Liliana Castro-Molano, Humberto Escalante, Jaime Martí-Herrero
This study analyzes the influence of various solar passive heating designs in the thermal performance of low-cost tubular digesters in cold climate regions. Five full-scale low-cost tubular digesters were monitored...
